5.7.4 Return Value
A function in C or C
++
is required to have a return type. The RTE only uses the function
return value to return application error codes of a server operation.
[SWS_Rte_01130]
⌈
A function implementing a runnable entity entry point shall only
have the return type
Std_ReturnType
, if the runnable entity represents a server op-
eration and the AUTOSAR interface description of that client server communication
lists potential application errors. All other functions implementing a runnable entity
entry point shall have a return type of
void
.
⌋
(SRS_Rte_00124, SRS_Rte_00031)
Note: If the potential application errors include
RTE_E_OK
, this shall also lead to a
return type of
Std_ReturnType
.
